reviews_captured_by_me.text: We had a great experience with Elizabeth Kitchen and Granite. Juan diligently helped resolve a quartz issue with the supplier, the office kept me updated, the fabricator was very skilled, and the installation team did a great job. The price was good and the process took a little longer than expected; however, most of it was out of the hands of the company.
